$Comment: Old Jack's board, drawn once a day at midnight UTC, one contract per slot. A slot posts only
contracts whose Boards entry names its Difficulty band. Hallows_Eve_Night holds the creature
contracts, which can only be finished after dark; Hallows_Eve_Day holds the ones a player can
finish in daylight; Hallows_Eve_Skill holds the four skill contracts this pack adds for a server
running MMO Skill Tree (the Mmo_Hallows_Eve_Daily files).
Favor with Old Jack opens more of the board. The third and fourth slots carry Requires: the
second Night job opens at Friendly, the second Day job at Honored. Everyone sees them posted,
and a player below the rank sees them locked, with the reason. Each band has two contracts on
an ordinary day (three on Harvest Moon nights), so a band fills two slots at most.
The skill slot is Optional: where nothing carries its band the board shows no gap. A contract
naming this board without a band is never drawn, so a companion's contract names one of these
bands, or a band of its own with a slot added here. Grades names each band for the badge on its
rows; a band left out reads through the key board.grade.<band>, which the mod filling it can
ship. Season makes the board absent while the event is off. Its contracts' pay waits here
until the player collects it (Rewards.Claim); a job left uncollected when the event ends shows
Collect in the player's Objective Book instead, since a contract whose board is gone is
collected anywhere. Order 90 keeps it behind a server's everyday boards. Where keeps it
in the Forgotten Temple: anywhere else it is left out of every list and opens closed.
